title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Notorious
The Chatham County Detention Center hosts an inmate who faces a life sentence for murdering his spouse; another inmate's illegal business stands in the way of him graduating from the jail's strict substance abuse program.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Back in Orange
One inmate is tested when he returns to general population after spending months in the segregation unit; another inmate vows to do damage because he feels like an outcast.

title: Lockup: Cincinnati: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Snitch-innati
A jail shakedown recovers a huge stash of contraband; a young couple is charged with robbery and murder, but as judgment day approaches, one of their lives might depend on the choices of another.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Solitary
A new inmate struggles with life on the tough side of the jail; another inmate is offered a chance to improve his condition but mounts a defense anyway; a female inmate requires some special attention from staff members.

title: Lockup: Fairfax: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Counterfeit Lives
A self-described white supremacist may not be who he says he is and that could make him a marked man among other white supremacists; another inmate attempts to hide the true nature of his recent conviction.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Thicker Than a Bowl of Oatmeal
A gang leader has his authority challenged by another inmate, but questions arise over whether the challenger is who he says he is; in the women's wing, one inmate's personality divides her housing unit; before long, verbal altercations turn violent.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — God Is Not Here
A familiar face struggles to escape the jail's revolving door, but there's a catch; another inmate has pled guilty to manslaughter, but now in an unusual legal twist, he may have to stand trial for murder.

title: Lockup: Tulsa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Beat Down
A convicted sex offender becomes the victim of a brutal assault that leaves him unconscious and in the hospital; his assailants say the attack was warranted, but what they don't know might bring regret.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Hard on the Yard
One man prepares for life behind bars after running someone down with his car; another man must be placed in isolation for his own protection, after being accused of knowingly giving women HIV.
